{{Quote|Competition out there is something crazy. Couple of hunters died in the jungles. Big Trandoshan got arrested by the Imperials.|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="Musty">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Musty Trail|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
'''Shada Hsskhor''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who competed to participated in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Hsskhor was one of a dozen hunters who competed for the last spot in the Great Hunt, and during his pursuit of the three [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] he had been assigned,<ref name="Huntmaster" /> he was arrested in the jungles of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Musty" /> However, he still succeeded in acquiring his targets, and competed in the [[Grand Melee]] against several other hunters&mdash;though he was slain in the fighting. He carried a pair of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and wore [[Color/Legends|black]] and gold [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Melee" />
